echo '=== FINAL VALIDATION SNAPSHOT ==='
echo '--- compose ps (project harbor-local) ---'
cd /workspace/deploy/compose/example/local && docker compose -f ../../docker-compose.yaml --env-file .env ps 2>&1
echo
echo '--- volumes ---'
docker volume ls | grep -i harbor
echo
echo '--- UI ---'
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'http://localhost/ -> HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost/
echo '--- health ---'
curl -s http://localhost/api/v2.0/health | tr -d '\n' | head -c 200; echo
echo '--- core version (from logs) ---'
docker logs harbor-local-core-1 2>&1 | grep 'Version: 2.15.0' | head -1
